prompt: Challenge C138-CH1: Our die-cutting machine is producing burrs and uneven creases on micro-corrugated E-flute when humidity in the hall goes above 65% — box com

content.text: {"expertise": [{"text": "Research on embossing methods for E-flute corrugated microflute board quantifies substrate damage including flute crush and delamination, with measurement of dot height uniformity and within-cell variation across embossing techniques.", "sources": [{"id": "SYN-PUB-05885", "field": "abstract", "quote": "Dot height, dot density uniformity, and substrate damage (delamination, flute crush) were quantified across 120 samples per method-substrate combination."}]}, {"text": "Design-of-experiments work on embossing pressure and die temperature identifies optimal process windows and documents how material properties such as fibre heterogeneity contribute to dot-base irregularity and springback variation.", "sources": [{"id": "SYN-PUB-05882", "field": "abstract", "quote": "Springback in the 100 % RC grade reached 28 % compared with 14 % in virgin board under identical conditions."}]}, {"text": "Cross-sectional microscopy and profilometry methods are routinely applied to measure surface deformation, material thickness reduction, and edge-slope characteristics in die-cutting and embossing processes.", "sources": [{"id": "SYN-PUB-05884", "field": "abstract", "quote": "Symbol sharpness was quantified by edge-slope angle measured via optical profilometry"}]}], "fit": "partial", "fitReason": "The researcher's publications address embossing-induced substrate deformation, flute crush, and process parameter optimization on corrugated microflute board [SYN-PUB-05885, SYN-PUB-05882], but do not examine moisture effects on die-cutting quality, compression strength degradation, or humidity control strategies relevant to the challenge."}
